On 3 November 2022, pNetwork's pGALA bridge on BNB Chain suffered a loss of contract owner privileges, enabling arbitrary minting of unbacked pGALA tokens. pNetwork executed an emergency drain, minting and selling 55.6 billion pGALA to extract 12,977 BNB (~$4.3 million) from PancakeSwap, but recovery and reimbursement remain disputed. A misconfiguration during deployment resulted in lost control over the pGALA mint authority on BNB Chain. The contract owner could mint unlimited tokens, bypassing collateralization. Project accounts report this was due to a leaked governance key, possibly via a public GitHub repository, but direct proof of the leak location is not established.
